installApp.title: Download App
installApp.subtitle: Install CSC News on your device
installApp.pageSubtitle: Install CSC News on your phone or computer for a faster local app experience.
installApp.howToAdd: Add to Home Screen — how to
installApp.iosStep1: Open this page in Safari (required for "Add to Home Screen").
installApp.iosStep2: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow) — bottom bar on iPhone, top on iPad.
installApp.iosStep3: Scroll and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
installApp.iosChromeNote: Chrome or other browsers on iOS still use Apple's WebKit — use their menu (Share or ⋮) and look for Add to Home Screen.
installApp.manualNoButton: This browser doesn't support the one‑click install button
installApp.safariDock: Use File → Add to Dock (Safari on Mac) or the share menu if available.
installApp.otherBrowserMenu: Use your browser's menu: Install app or Install CSC News.
installApp.installDismissed: Installation was dismissed. You can click the button again later.
installApp.helpChrome: Chrome / Edge (desktop or Android): Menu (⋮) → Install CSC News or Install app.
installApp.helpWhyUnavailable: Why one‑click install may be unavailable: Only Chromium on desktop/Android exposes the install prompt. You need HTTPS (or localhost for dev), a valid manifest, a registered service worker, and 192×192 and 512×512 PNG icons. Open this site first, then come back here — the prompt can appear after a short moment. If you already installed the app, uninstall it to see the button again.
installApp.helpIos: iPhone/iPad: Apple does not allow websites to show an install popup. Add to Home Screen is the supported way to pin CSC News; use Safari for the clearest steps above.
installApp.ariaShowSteps: Show how to add this app to your home screen
